recognize_zh: 這是 CD25 免疫組化：一片中大型、核呈卵圓至腎形的腫瘤細胞，大多只有淡藍色背景染色，僅少數細胞胞質內可見細顆粒狀棕色染色，屬弱且局部陽性，需搭配 CD117/tryptase 判讀為異常肥大細胞表現 CD25。
features: Sheet of medium to large cells with oval, indented to reniform nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Fine, dot-like granular brown cytoplasmic staining in scattered cells only
Most tumor cells show no convincing membranous or cytoplasmic CD25 signal
No strong, crisp membranous staining pattern identifiable at this magnification
Occasional small vacuoles/fat spaces in a densely cellular background
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD25 on a densely cellular infiltrate composed of medium to large cells with oval to reniform nuclei and moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm. Only scattered cells show weak, fine granular cytoplasmic staining; the majority of the infiltrate lacks definite reactivity, and the dot-like pattern should be distinguished from pigment or nonspecific deposits. Interpretation requires correlation with CD117 and tryptase stains on the same infiltrate; aberrant CD25 expression by mast cells, if confirmed, supports systemic mastocytosis, here in the context of mast cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Pigment is refractile and golden-brown, is present on an unstained control slide, and is not confined to the cytoplasm of cells that coexpress CD117/tryptase.

ddx.dx: CD25+ activated T cells or regulatory T cells
ddx.vs: T cells are small lymphocytes with membranous CD25 that are CD3-positive and tryptase-negative, unlike the larger oval-nucleated mast cells.
Reactive mast cells are scattered, round, and CD25-negative, whereas neoplastic mast cells form clusters or sheets and express CD25 and/or CD2.
